report.clinical_summary: The patient reports fatigue and headaches that are getting more frequent, with unpredictable fluctuations between good and bad days. They struggle to get out of bed on difficult days and find work challenging when symptoms hit. Mood can get low. They've been on Triumeq for several years but sometimes miss doses and feel the medication isn't providing as much relief as hoped. They worry about missing doses and virus spread, long-term side effects, dependency, and the future. They identify some self-care actions that provide agency but feel much is out of their control.
